instruction: Identify whether Albion Basin offers electric hookups for RVs.

metadata.explanation: Variation 8: Task checks if electric hookups are available at Albion Basin. Similar pattern, checking amenity information.
metadata.verification_notes: Uses existing check_direct_json_object metric and active_tab_html_parse getter. Checks amenity features common on recreation.gov.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_tab_html_parse extracts HTML class elements from active Chrome tab with category='class' and class_multiObject configuration
Data extraction is semantically appropriate: extracts text content from element with class 'rec-amenity-electric' which is the standard class name for amenity information on recreation.gov
Metric comparison logic is correct: check_direct_json_object compares result['rec-amenity-electric'] with expected value 'No'
Expected value is semantically correct: 'No' indicates that Albion Basin does not offer electric hookups for RVs
Data flow is correct: getter extracts {'rec-amenity-electric': <text>}, metric receives rules dict with 'expected' key, comparison works correctly
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the specific amenity requirement stated in the instruction
Practical feasibility: the task config opens recreation.gov, user navigates to Albion Basin page, getter can extract amenity info from the active tab
